title: Checklist steps skipped for one edit keep that edit's reason when carried onto later versions
description: Found 2026-11-08: a bulk run skipped the open review steps on 76 legacy published stories with the reason 'Legacy story published before the checklist; this edit only removes an AI-drafted disclaimer'. The skipped state (with that reason) is carried forward onto later versions, so papyrus stories next now shows it for stories whose later edits were NOT disclaimer removals: the reason is false for them. Each skip must record the version it was made for and the kind of change (text unchanged, picture only, text edited); a carried-forward skip is shown as 'skipped on vN: <reason>' and a later text edit reopens the steps whose lens reads text (see PPY-a2c230 for the scoping rules), instead of silently inheriting. Gherkin: skip recorded with its version, carried forward label, reopened by a text edit, not reopened by a picture-only edit. Also consider a command to list stories whose open or skipped steps carry a reason from an older version.
